sheets.content: 323 feature-level projection reproductions with original flags, numerical warnings and two coefficient cross-checks.
sheets.units_and_limits: Slopes in log-odds per tenfold CDS increase; diagnostics are numerical, not adjusted biological effects or tests.

fields.group: METAB, 285 metabolic-related Pfam domains; ADF_profile, 38 non-NARP anti-defense profiles.
fields.carriers: Number of reference genomes carrying the feature.
fields.beta: Observed ordinary-logit slope against log10 CDS count.
fields.null_valid: Original strict acceptance flag of the fixed-opportunity reference, not the projection.
fields.projection: Logit-scale slope projected from fixed-opportunity expected carrier counts.
fields.residual: Per-feature beta minus projected reference slope; descriptive difference.
fields.original_strict_valid: Projection passes original no-warning rule; FALSE for all 323 because of non-integer expected-count warnings.
fields.projection_converged: Projection GLM convergence flag, or number converged in group summary.
fields.projection_warnings: Actual warning text recorded from original binomial projection.
fields.quasi_projection: Quasibinomial cross-check of the deterministic projection coefficient.
fields.quasi_converged: Quasibinomial convergence flag, or number converged in group summary.
fields.quasi_warnings: Warning text from quasibinomial coefficient check; blank means none recorded.
fields.independent_projection: Coefficient from independent weighted cross-entropy minimization.
fields.independent_converged: Independent numerical convergence flag, or number converged in summary.
fields.independent_max_score: Maximum absolute normalized score in independent numerical solution.
fields.beta_difference: Reproduced beta minus archived beta; floating-point check only.
fields.independent_difference: Independent cross-entropy coefficient minus original projection.

sheets.content: Fixed-set summaries of per-feature slopes/differences and projection convergence; original strict-valid counts are zero.
sheets.units_and_limits: Group n counts fixed features (285/38), not independent biological samples; median residual is median of per-feature differences.

fields.group: METAB, 285 metabolic-related Pfam domains; ADF_profile, 38 non-NARP anti-defense profiles.
fields.n: Number of annotated gene sites (position table) or features (projection summary).
fields.median_beta: Median observed beta in the fixed feature set.
fields.median_projection: Median projected reference slope in the fixed feature set.
fields.median_residual: Median of per-feature beta minus projected slope, not a difference of group medians.
fields.projection_converged: Projection GLM convergence flag, or number converged in group summary.
fields.original_strict_valid: Projection passes original no-warning rule; FALSE for all 323 because of non-integer expected-count warnings.
fields.quasi_converged: Quasibinomial convergence flag, or number converged in group summary.
fields.independent_converged: Independent numerical convergence flag, or number converged in summary.
